scope: RNA-defined macrophage detection and candidate RNA states; protein evidence is not required or collected in this workflow
constraints: Keep existing lineage memberships, RNA zeros and cycling cells; no paired DE, depth regression/matching or GSE154906; do not change a zero RNA observation to detected based on a state score
lineage_evidence: Descriptive corroboration if >=2 measured core markers detected AND >=1 broad myeloid marker detected; this is not a validated lineage classifier or an exclusion rule. Other-lineage marker flags are review prompts, not doublet diagnoses
state_screen_interpretation: Already computed cross-cohort diagnostics are archived evidence only; they are not acceptance gates for this task. Primary next analysis uses selected-scope pooled RNA contrasts and competing-lineage discrimination, with internal patient/sample holdout, not whole-cohort validation.
prior_evidence: Reuse completed v6 unsupervised programs and v7 heldout mixture outputs rather than repeat unchanged analyses; removing protein as a requirement does not change these numerical failures

acceptance.scope_note: Independent RNA identity can strengthen validation, but it is not a prerequisite to the operational raw-count>0 label. Protein/cross-cohort proof are not requested. Bulk recovery and cell-vs-RNA calibration remain separate.

publication: New separate folder; preserve historical analyses. No TCGA or survival rerun until RNA identity/mixture/unit gates pass
user_scope_update: Protein and cross-cohort replication are not required, per current user steering
selected_scope: Pool all five primary HCC cohorts; supplementary cohorts annotated separately, no independent vote

pooled_analysis.selection: Pooled cell-level Mann-Whitney tie-corrected DE with FDR<0.05, log2FC>=1, positive detection>=10%; PGAM5 anchor selected separately; no cohort vote or donor-direction acceptance threshold
pooled_analysis.internal_split: Fixed seed20261010; hold about30% donor/sample labels within every cohort, preserving whole label across all lineages; GSE202642 labels remain sample proxies
pooled_analysis.state_features: Up to50 strict pooled upregulated genes not in finite cycle/stress or MT/RPL/RPS lists and target/maximum nonmacrophage balanced reference mean log2 ratio>=1 (pseudocount0.05); competitors include cycling and Unknown
pooled_analysis.lineage_features: Always include all measured RNA lineage/competitor panel genes, PGAM5 and top15 broad reference genes per supported group; lineage markers need not be differential between macrophage RNA states
pooled_analysis.reference: Equal cohort then equal available donor per group; retain PGAM5-detected/undetected and cycling macrophages separately with supported-group fallback
pooled_analysis.solver: Fixed v7 robust FCLS ridge0.001,3 IRLS updates, target-only PGAM5 upper bound. No choosing solver or thresholds from held samples
pooled_analysis.query: Reuse existing actual v5 cell mixtures ONLY for donors excluded from pooled training. Evaluate standard0/0.5/1/2/5%, variable total macrophage, PGAM5-positive nonmacrophage and pure competitor challenges in2units
pooled_analysis.full_training: After fixed internal evaluation, produce all-scope exploratory reference and full-scope descriptive pooled DE; final full-scope reference not scored on its own training cells as validation
pooled_analysis.interpretation: Internal computational validation only, no cross-cohort acceptance requirement or fresh independent patient claim; RNA coefficient vs cell fraction and TCGA platform compatibility remain uncalibrated
pooled_analysis.threshold_comparison: Both fixed in advance of pooled results; report all, do not choose a version using survival outcomes
pooled_analysis.primary_selection: No hard FDR or log2FC cutoff. After measurability/detection and finite cycle/stress/background rules, rank positive effect and competition differences continuously; take up to50 positive-score features. P/FDR/FC retained as descriptive evidence.
pooled_analysis.continuous_ranking_score: max(pooled log2FC,0) * max(target/max-nonmacrophage log2 ratio with pseudocount0.05,0) * target detection frequency
pooled_analysis.timing: Continuous-ranking extension fixed after user questioned cutoff necessity; original threshold-specific candidate counts were already seen. No selecting cutoff using TCGA outcomes; all internal results reported.
